test1_history_strict_precedence.detail: Confirmed that all trailing history features (prev_10, prev_3, days_since) draw exclusively from strictly prior timestamps.

test2_post_age_maturity_control.detail: Carousel advantage persists in mature posts (+0.1339) vs all (+0.2979); video penalty persists (-0.2746 vs -0.1093).

test3_cross_creator_overlap_and_leakage.detail: Verified zero creator leakage across GroupKFold splits. Documented cross-creator promo copy deduplication.

test4_follower_rounding_cancellation.detail: Exact mathematical cancellation: creator demeaning strictly eliminates follower-count scale and rounding errors.

test5_timestamp_gate_and_timing_validity.detail: Real timestamp coverage is 100.0%. However, timing features provide negligible predictive gain (-0.00054 MAE). Per Phase 3 rule, scheduler must fall back to generic prior rather than claiming validated timing signal.
